Bao Bao Bro is a man wearing a large bao headpiece. He has green eyes and the kanji "示畐" on the head. He advertizes for Hao Hao Steamed Buns in Metro City's Chinatown district, and is admired by Li-Fen.

page.overview:
Who is Bao Bao Bro?

Bao Bao Bro is a man wearing a large bao headpiece. He has green eyes and the kanji "示畐" on the head. He advertizes for Hao Hao Steamed Buns in Metro City's Chinatown district, and is admired by Li-Fen.

A person dressed like Bao Bao Bro can be seen in the stage The Macho Ring and in World Tour mode.

In World Tour, Hao Hao Steamed Buns is running a contest where whoever catches the agile Bao Bao Bro running around Metro City will earn a year's supply of food. Li-Fen asks the Avatar to catch him and win the prize for her.

Bao Bao Bro is one of the pictures decorating Li-Fen's laptop, and the item Bao Bao Bro Sticker is one of the best gifts for Jamie.
